{{Top|leg}}
'''Nebellia''' was a virus that could cause respiratory tract problems and diarrhea.<ref name="Imperial Commando: 501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mij Gilamar]] gave [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Ovolot Qail Uthan]] a few samples of nebellia virus. Uthan used the virus in her work to develop an antigen for the [[FG36]], a deadly virus she created that was being used by [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="Imperial Commando: 501st" />
